chars.MOTHER: an elegant Moroccan woman in her early forties, shoulder-length wavy black hair, plum-coloured satin blouse, small gold hoop earrings
chars.BOY: a tall broad-shouldered Moroccan young man of 18, short black fade haircut, mustard-yellow hoodie, dark grey joggers
chars.GIRL: a Moroccan girl of 18 with long straight dark brown hair, cream knit beanie, light blue puffer jacket
chars.NEIGHBOUR: a middle-aged Moroccan woman in a green floral house djellaba and a white headscarf

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: MOTHER stands in her modern Casablanca apartment kitchen, whispering secretly into her phone held close to her mouth, one hand covering the phone, glancing nervously toward the door, seen from the hallway doorway, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, worried secretive expression, warm evening light

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: GIRL in a snowy Canadian student room at night, sitting on her bed, angrily talking at her phone in a video call, pointing at the camera, accusing jealous expression, head-to-waist, face visible, window with snow behind her

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: BOY sitting on his bed in a small Casablanca bedroom, holding his phone at arm's length on a video call, rolling his eyes and rubbing his forehead, exhausted and annoyed, head-to-waist, face visible

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: BOY standing by his bedroom window at night, frowning, thumb pressing firmly on his phone screen as if blocking someone, determined angry face, phone screen seen from behind so no text visible, head-to-waist

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: BOY lying on his back on his bed in a dim Casablanca bedroom, phone resting face-down on his chest, staring at the ceiling, thoughtful and relieved, seen from the side

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: BOY sitting at a cafe terrace in Casablanca in daylight, his phone buzzing and lighting up on the table, he leans in surprised with raised eyebrows, mint tea glass beside it, head-to-waist, face visible

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: MOTHER sitting on the edge of a sofa in her elegant living room, phone pressed to her ear, leaning forward and speaking urgently in a low voice, pleading anxious eyes, curtains half closed, head-to-waist, face visible

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: BOY walking in a Casablanca street with phone to his ear, stopping and frowning uncomfortably, shaking his head no, uneasy expression, head-to-waist, face visible, white buildings and palm trees behind

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: NEIGHBOUR peeking out from behind a lace curtain at an apartment window across the street at dusk, one eye narrowed, nosy suspicious expression, watching someone below, head-to-waist, face visible, Casablanca balconies with plants
